newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa trade figures postponed, due Thurs or Fri.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa trade figures postponed, due Thurs or Fri.

text.p: South African July trade figures, due for release at 0800 GMT, have been postponed, a spokeswoman said.
The figures are now expected to be released on Thursday or Friday, she said.
The South African Revenue Service spokeswoman gave no reason for the delay.
A Reuters consensus poll of economists forecast an average 600 million rand surplus for July after a 27.6 million rand deficit in June.
